ENCOUNTER NOTE
Date: 2020-01-15
Provider: Dr. Sarah Chen, MD
Department: Obstetrics & Gynecology
Visit Type: outpatient

CHIEF COMPLAINT:
Inability to conceive after 14 months of unprotected intercourse

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS:
She and her partner have been attempting to conceive for 14 months without success. Her menses are regular every 28–30 days.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY:
She has no history of sexually transmitted infections, pelvic surgery, or endometriosis.

ALLERGIES:
No known drug allergies

FAMILY HISTORY:
- Maternal grandmother: Type 2 diabetes mellitus
- Mother: Hypothyroidism
- Father: Essential hypertension
- No family history of infertility, endometriosis, or early menopause

SOCIAL HISTORY:
Smoking: Never smoker. Alcohol: None. Occupation: High school mathematics teacher.

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION:
Physical examination is normal

LABORATORY DATA:
Her partner's semen analysis is normal. Laboratory studies reveal normal TSH, prolactin, FSH, and LH levels.

IMAGING:
Transvaginal ultrasound reveals a normal uterus and bilateral ovaries with small antral follicles. A hysterosalpingogram is shown.

ASSESSMENT AND PLAN:
She is diagnosed with unexplained infertility

She is prescribed clomiphene citrate to promote ovulation.

ENCOUNTER NOTE
Date: 2021-07-15
Provider: Dr. James O'Brien, MD
Department: Emergency Medicine
Visit Type: ed

CHIEF COMPLAINT:
Sudden onset left-sided lower abdominal pain

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS:
The patient is a 29-year-old female with a history of female infertility and prior clomiphene citrate challenge testing. She presents to the clinic with a complaint of left-sided lower abdominal pain that started abruptly earlier in the day. She describes the pain as sharp and intermittent, rating it a 6 out of 10 in intensity. Her last menstrual period began 14 days ago and was of normal volume and duration. She has a regular 28-day menstrual cycle and is not currently sexually active. She does not use any form of contraception and has no history of sexually transmitted infections.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY:
Active Problem List:
- Female infertility (diagnosed 2020-01-15)
- Clomiphene citrate challenge testing indication (diagnosed 2020-03-15)

MEDICATIONS:
She takes no medications.

ALLERGIES:
No known drug allergies

FAMILY HISTORY:
- Maternal grandmother: Type 2 diabetes mellitus
- Mother: Hypothyroidism
- Father: Essential hypertension
- No family history of infertility, endometriosis, or early menopause

SOCIAL HISTORY:
Smoking: Never smoker. Alcohol: None. Occupation: High school mathematics teacher.

REVIEW OF SYSTEMS:
She denies any nausea, vomiting, fever, or urinary symptoms.

VITAL SIGNS:
On physical examination, her vital signs are within normal limits.

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION:
Abdominal examination reveals mild tenderness to palpation in the left lower quadrant with no rebound or guarding. There is no costovertebral angle tenderness. A pelvic examination is unremarkable with no cervical motion tenderness, adnexal tenderness, or masses palpated.

LABORATORY DATA:
Urinalysis is negative for leukocyte esterase, nitrites, blood, and pregnancy test is negative.

ENCOUNTER NOTE
Date: 2020-03-15
Provider: Dr. Sarah Chen, MD
Department: Obstetrics & Gynecology
Visit Type: outpatient

CHIEF COMPLAINT:
Follow-up for infertility workup and ovarian reserve testing

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS:
The patient returns for follow-up regarding her inability to conceive following her initial presentation in January 2020. She and her husband have been trying to conceive for 14 months. Her menstrual cycles are regular every 29 days and associated with mild cramps, but no abnormal bleeding or pelvic pain.

PAST MEDICAL HISTORY:
Active Problem List:
- Female infertility (diagnosed 2020-01-15)

ALLERGIES:
No known drug allergies

FAMILY HISTORY:
- Maternal grandmother: Type 2 diabetes mellitus
- Mother: Hypothyroidism
- Father: Essential hypertension
- No family history of infertility, endometriosis, or early menopause

SOCIAL HISTORY:
She does not smoke or drink alcohol and has a healthy body mass index.

PHYSICAL EXAMINATION:
Her physical examination is unremarkable.

LABORATORY DATA:
Initial lab work shows a normal TSH, prolactin, FSH, LH, and estradiol.

IMAGING:
As part of her infertility workup, a hysterosalpingogram is performed.

OTHER STUDIES:
Her partner's semen analysis is within normal limits.
